chunks: "The foundation of the House extends from the seventh lower earth to the seventh upper earth."
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the foundation of the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام describes the Ka'bah as having a foundation that spans the full vertical extent of the layered earths. The hadith conveys the cosmic significance and sacred centrality of the House in relation to hajj and divine worship.
